reference.caveat: budding yeast at 1 kb has no compartments worth the name, so this correlation is mostly a correlation of noise and the measured floor is low. The eigensolver itself is proved against `direct`, which is a full numpy.linalg.eigh of the same correlation matrix.
differences: cooltools clips O/E at a percentile and fills missing with the mean; this repo leaves a gap a gap
cooltools may phase by GC; this run asks for no phasing track
cooltools sorts its eigenvectors by explained variance, so E1 is not necessarily the same eigenvector this repo calls the first

sign: up to a flip — phasing is what makes it meaningful (§16.6)
